entries.german: Das Domcapitel und das Johanniterhaus zu Wirzburg beurkunden den Schiedspruch über ihre Zwistigkeiten vom 23. August. Wir Karl von Hesseburg techant vnd daz gantz capitel gemeynlichen des styftes zü dem tume zü Wirtzburg bekennen offenlichen an disem brief fur vns vnd alle vnser nachkumen, daz wir vmb alle schulde bruche zü sprüche vnd zweyunge dy wir von vnsers styftes wegen biz her han gehabt mit vnd zü den ersamen geiſtlichen luten dem comentür vnd dem conuent des huſes zü Wirtzburg sant Johans ordens des heiligen ſpitals zü Jhe-ruſalem fruntlichen vnd gutlichen mit vnserm guten willen verriht vnd geeynt sin vff dy erbern lute die wir vff beide siten dar zü beſcheiden haben: vff vnsere vnd vnsers capitels siten hern Ar-nolden von Sparneck vnd hern Nycalusz von Malközz, tumherren in vnserm vorgenanten styfte; her Friderich Zuren cuſter, her Nyclaus Danyel sangmeister in dem styfte zum Nuwenmünſter vff dy andern siten: her Cunrat von Geu-rychsheim techant in dem sel-ben styft zum Nuwenmünſter. der zü einem vngeraden vff beide siten gegeben vnd genümet ist. Wir Cunrat von Bybera baliger zü Francken vnd comentur zü Wizzense, Johans Mercklin comentür, bruder Cunrat Kyſeling, Hans Megelin, Heinrich Trühſezz, bruder Han, bruder Rychart, vnd der conuente gemeinlichen des hus zü Wirtzburg sant Johans ordens des heiligen spi-tals von Jherusalem bekennen offenlich an disem brief fur vns vnd fur alle vnsere nachkumen, daz wir von aller schulde bruche vnd züſprüche vnd zweyunge wegen als vns vnd vnserm hus dy erwirdigen herren der . . te-chant vnd daz capitel des styfts züm tume zü Wirtzburg von des selben irs styfts wegen haben zü gesprochen vnd an gerecht biz her daz wir vmb dy selben schulde brüche züſprüche vnd zweyunge gutlich vnd fruntlichen mit vnserm gutem willen sin ver-ryht vnd geeynt mit in vff dy erbern lute dy hernach geschriben sten: her Arnolt von Sparn-eck, her Nyclaus von Mal-kös, tumherren in dem obgenan-ten styfte zü Wirtzburg, vf ire siten; her Friderich Zürn cuſter, her Nyclaus Danyel sangmeiſter im styfte zum Nuwen munster vf vnser siten; her Cunrat von Gewrychsheim techant in dem selben styfte züm Nüwen munster, der da zü einem vngeraden vf beide siten gegeben ist. Vnd dy selben funfe eynmütlichen haben vns geryht vnd geeynt in aller wyse als hernach von worten zü worten geschriben stet: Wir Arnolt von Sparneck, Nyclaus von Mal-kozz, tumherren zü Wirtzburg, Cunrat von Geu-rychsheim techant des styfts zum Nuwenmünster zü Wirtzburg, Nyclaus Danyel vnd .Friderich Zuren, korherren in dem selben styft zum Nuwen-münster, bekennen vnd tun kunt offenlichen an disem brief allen den die in an sehen oder horen lesen: vmb alle vorderunge clage vnd ansprach kryeg zweyunge vnd gebresten als dy erbern herren der techant vnd daz ca-pitel des styfts zum tume zü Wirtzburg vf ein siten, vnd der comentür vnd dy bruder gemeinlichen in dem huſe zü Wirtzburg sant Johans ordens des heiligen spitals von Jherusalem vnd auch dy pfleger des selben hūſs vff dy andern siten gen ein ander gehabt haben, von zinse güt gulte vnd schulde wegen als dy vorgenanten heuſer herren dem techant vnd dem capitel des vorgenanten styfts zum tume schuldig sin als hernach geschriben stet, des hat der techant vnd daz capitel des vorgenanten styfts zum tume vff ire siten dar zu geben vnd bescheiden vns zwen Arnolden von Sparneck vnd Nyclauſz von Malközz obgenant; so haben dy vorgenanten heuſer herren des hus zü Wirtzburg vff ir siten dar zu geben vnd bescheiden vns zwen Nyclaus Danyel vnd Friderich Zürn obgenant; vnd dy vorgenant beide party haben mich Cunrat von Geurychsheim techant zum Nuwen-munster, den obgenanten, zu einem obman geben vnd be-scheiden in disn sachen: vnd dy vorgenant beide party haben wir auch globt mit hant gegeben trüwen an eydes stat, waz wir funfe oder der merteil zwyſchen den vor-genanten beiden partyen scheiden oder machen, daz sullen sy vf beide siten stet vnd vest halten vff dy trüwe dy sy dar vber geben haben vnd vff dy pene als hernach-geschriben stet on geuerde. Des ersten so haben wir funf obgenant eintmutlichen gemacht vnd gescheiden, daz dy vorgenanten herren von Sant Johans dem techant vnd dem capitel des vorgenanten styfts schicken sullen von den von Rosenberg von iren erben oder von iren nachkumen dy Boxperg jn haben oder in gewinnen gut brief vnd vrkunde noch haltunge vnd sage der notein der bede party vber eyn kumen sin vmb dy zehen phunt heller vnd vier malter weizzes jerlicher gulte dy sy von alter her gehabt haben vff dem huſe vnd stat zü Boxperg mit sinen zü ge-horenden. Daz sol geschehen vnd ein ende nemen vnuer-zögenlichen hye zwischen vnd wyhenahten dy nü schierst kumen ön geuerde. Were aber daz dy herren von sant Johans der vorgenanten brief vnd vrkunde niht geschicken konden von den von Rosenberg in der wyse als vor-geschriben stet, so sullen sy dem techant vnd dem styfte zü Wirtzburg die obgeschriben jerlichen gulte bewysen vnd verſchriben vff dem hus zü sant Johans zü Wirtz-burg vnd vff dem hoff züm Hofschultheizzcn gelegen in der stat zü Wirtzburg mit iren zugehorenden also daz sy der obgeschriben jerlichen gulte sicher vnd gewys sin sullen als vff andern iren zinsguten so lange biz daz Bybelriet daz hūs wider in des ordens hant kumet: so sullen sy danne dy obgenant jerlichen gulte bewysen vnd verſchriben daz sy der furbaz dar vff habende sin vnd warten sullen als vff andern iren zinsguten. Vnd daz sol geschehen mit gunst willen vnd verhenckniss vnsers herren von Wirtzburg. Vnd daz auch dem techant vnd dem capitel des vorgenanten styfts daz volendet vnd volbraht werde in der wyse als vorgeschriben stet, dar nach sullen dy vorgenanten herren von sant Johans vnd ir nachkumen getrulichen werben schicken vnd vol-enden vf die trüwe dy sy dar vber gegeben haben ön alles geuerde. Dar nach so haben wir funf obgenant einmütlichen gemacht vnd gescheiden, daz dy vorgenanten herren von Sant Johans jerlichen reichen vnd geben sullen dem techant vnd dem capitel des vorgenanten styfts vnd iren nachkumen viertzig phunt wahs in aller wyse vnd mözze als sy in dy von alter her gegeben haben. Were aber daz dy ob-genanten herren von sant Johans dy gut da von sy die selben viertzig phunt wahs geben konden vnd mohten ledig vnd lös gemachen in disen drüwen jaren von allen erbschaften rehten zinsen vnd gulten, vnd in dy auch lediclichen mohten geantwurten vnd vſſ geben fur fry eygen gut vnd ön alles hindernisse, so sullen sy dy selben gut von den herren von sant Johans vſnemen: vnd sullen sy danne der viertzig phunde wahs jerlicher gulte ledig vnd los sagen on geuerde. Auch haben wir obgenant funf einmutlichen gemacht vnd gescheiden, daz dy vorgenanten herren von sant Jo-hans sullen beluhten vnd brunnen die aht lampen lieht in dem styft zum tume zu Wirtzburg, der sint siben vff sant Kylians köre, vnd eins vor vnſer frauwen altare. Daz sullen sy tün als sy die von alter her gebrant haben ön hindernisse hie zwischen vnd sant Martins tag der schirest kumpt. Vnd sy sullen danne vff den selben sant Martins tag vnuerzögenlichen reychen geben vnd antwurten den obgenanten herren dem techant vnd dem capitel des vorgenanten styfts vnd allen iren nachkumen furbaz alle jare ewichlichen vff sant Martins tag jerlichen zwen zentner oleys: da mit sol man danne die vor-genanten aht lieht brunnen daz jare vz on geuerde. Ez sullen auch dy herren von sant Johans jerlichen reichen vnd geben den kyrnchern in dem obgenanten styfte zum tume alle dy reht zinse vnd gulte in aller wyse vnd mozze als sy daz von alter her geton haben on hinder-nisse vnd widerr[ed]e on geuerde. Auch haben wir alle funf einmutlichen gemacht vnd gescheiden, daz dy obgenant beyde party alle vorge-schriben dinck stunde bunde vnd artikel stet halten sullen in aller wyse vnd mozze als vorgeschriben stet. Vnd welch party des vz gienge, vnd niht hielte yegelichen artikel besonder als hy vorgeschriben stet, wy ofte oder wy dicke daz geschehe, ye als dicke vnd als ofte ist dy selbe bruchig party veruallen zü pene vmb zweyntzig guldin, dy sy geben sullen der party dy da niht gebrochen haben, vnd vmb zweintzig guldin an vnser frawen ca-pellen vff dem juden platz, vnd vns obgenanten schideluten auch vmb zweintzig guldin, von den man in danne nihts lazzcn sol. Diser vnd aller vorgeschriben dinge zü eym gezüg-nisse vnd worem vrkund so haben wir schidelute obge-nant vnser yeglicher sin eygen jnsigel gehangen an disem brief, der geben ist nach vnsers herren Cristes geburte drutzehen hundert iar da nach in dem sehs vnd ahtzigstem iar, an sant Bartholomeus abent des heilgen zwelfboten.
entries.english: The Cathedral Chapter and the House of the Knights Hospitaller in Würzburg certify the arbitration award concerning their disputes of August 23. We, Karl von Hesseburg, Dean, and the entire chapter of the cathedral in Würzburg, openly declare by this letter for us and all our successors, that we, concerning all debts and breaches disputes and disagreements that we and our chapter have had until now with the honorable clerics, the commander, and the convent of the House of St. John's Order of the Holy Hospital in Jerusalem, friendly and amicable with our good will, have settled and agreed upon, and have appointed for this purpose on both sides the honorable people who are written below: on our side and that of our chapter, Master Arnold von Sparneck and Master Nycalusz von Malközz, canons in our aforesaid chapter; Master Friderich Zuren, custos; Master Nyclaus Danyel, choirmaster in the chapter of Neuemünster; and on the other side: Master Cunrat von Gewrychsheim, dean in the same chapter of Neuemünster, who is given and named as an impartial arbiter for both sides. We, Cunrat von Bybera, Bailiff in Franconia and Commander in Wizzense, Johans Mercklin, Commander, Brother Cunrat Kyselng, Hans Megelin, Heinrich Trühsez, Brother Han, Brother Rychart, and the convent of the House of St. John's Order of the Holy Hospital of Jerusalem openly declare by this letter for us and for all our successors, that we, concerning all debts, breaches, disputes and disagreements, as they and our house have had with the venerable lords, the dean and the chapter of the cathedral in Würzburg, on their side and on the part of their chapter, we have settled and agreed upon them amicably and in good will with those honorable people who are written below: on their side, Master Arnolt von Sparneck, Master Nyclaus von Malkös, canons in the aforementioned chapter in Würzburg; on our side, Master Friderich Zürn, custos; Master Nyclaus Danyel, choirmaster in the chapter of Neuemünster; Master Cunrat von Gewrychsheim, dean in the same chapter of Neuemünster, who is given as an impartial arbiter for both sides. And these five have amicably settled and agreed with us in all ways as is written word for word hereinafter: We, Arnolt von Sparneck, Nycalusz von Malközz, canons in Würzburg, Cunrat von Geurychsheim, dean of the chapter of Neuemünster in Würzburg, Nyclaus Danyel and Friderich Zuren, canons in the same chapter of Neuemünster, acknowledge and make known by this letter to all who see or hear it: that concerning all claims, complaints, disputes, wars, disagreements, and defects that the honorable lords, the dean and the chapter of the cathedral in Würzburg, on one side, and the commander and the brothers of the House of St. John's Order of the Holy Hospital of Jerusalem in Würzburg, and also the administrators of the same house, on the other side, have had with each other, concerning rents, duties, and debts, as the aforesaid lords of the house are indebted to the dean and the chapter of the aforesaid chapter as is written hereinafter, which the dean and the chapter of the aforesaid chapter on their side are to give and assign to us, the two Arnold von Sparneck and Nycalusz von Malközz aforesaid; so the aforesaid lords of the house in Würzburg are to give and assign to us, the two Nyclaus Danyel and Friderich Zürn aforesaid, on their side; and the aforesaid two parties have appointed me, Cunrat von Geurychsheim, dean of Neuemünster, the aforesaid, as an arbiter in these matters: and the aforesaid two parties have also promised by hand given and sworn, whatever we five or the majority among the aforesaid two parties decide or make, they shall firmly and steadfastly adhere to it on the faith they have given concerning it, and under the penalty as is written hereinafter without fraud. Firstly, we five aforesaid have amicably agreed and settled that the aforesaid lords of Saint John shall send to the dean and the chapter of the aforesaid chapter, from the Rosenberg family, from their heirs or their successors, the good letters and documents concerning Boxberg, which they hold or will acquire, according to the tenor and declaration of both parties, concerning ten pounds Heller and four bushels of white annual rent that they have held from ancient times from the house and town of Boxberg with its appurtenances. This shall be done and concluded without delay here between now and the Christmas that is soon to come. But if the lords of Saint John could not send the aforesaid letter and document from the Rosenberg family in the manner as is written above, then they shall prove and assign the aforesaid annual duties to the dean and the chapter of the chapter in Würzburg, upon the house of Saint John in Würzburg and upon the court situated at the Hofschultheizen in the city of Würzburg, with its appurtenances, so that they shall be as secure and certain of the aforesaid annual duties as from their other reliable incomes, as long as the Bybelriet house does not return to the order's hand: then they shall prove and assign the aforesaid annual duties so that they shall continue to hold and expect them as from their other reliable incomes. And this shall be done with the good will and permission of our lord from Würzburg. And that also the dean and the chapter of the aforesaid chapter shall complete and fully carry out what is written above, and thereafter the aforesaid lords of Saint John and their successors shall faithfully strive and complete what they have promised concerning it without any fraud. Thereafter, we five aforesaid have amicably agreed and settled that the aforesaid lords of Saint John shall annually render and give to the dean and the chapter of the aforesaid chapter and their successors forty pounds of wax in all ways and measures as they have given it from ancient times. But if the aforesaid lords of Saint John could give the said forty pounds of wax from the property there, and make it free and clear within these three years from all rights of inheritance, rents, and duties, and could also freely answer and give it without any hindrance, then they shall take the said goods from the lords of Saint John: and they shall then declare the forty pounds of wax as annual duty free and clear forever. Also, we five aforesaid have amicably agreed and settled that the aforesaid lords of Saint John shall light and burn the eight lamps in the chapter of the cathedral in Würzburg, of which seven are on Saint Kilian's choir and one before our Lady's altar. This they shall do as they have burned them from ancient times, without hindrance, from now until Saint Martin's Day, which is soon to come. And they shall then, on the same Saint Martin's Day, without delay, give and deliver to the aforesaid lords, the dean, and the chapter of the aforesaid chapter, and all their successors, forever, on Saint Martin's Day, annually two centner of oil: with which the aforesaid eight lamps shall be burned for the year without fraud. Also, the lords of Saint John shall annually give and pay to the canons in the aforesaid chapter of the cathedral all due rents and duties in all ways and measures as they have done from ancient times, without hindrance and contradiction, without fraud. Also, we five have amicably agreed and settled that both parties aforesaid shall constantly observe all the written points, terms, and articles in all ways and measures as is written above. And whichever party deviates from this, and does not observe each article specifically as is written here, however often or how frequently that may happen, as often and as frequently as it occurs, the same breaching party shall fall into a penalty of twenty gulden, which they shall pay to the party that has not broken the agreement, and twenty gulden to our Lady's chapel in the Jewish quarter, and also twenty gulden to us, the aforesaid arbiters, of which nothing shall be left to them. In witness and true evidence of these and all the aforesaid things, we, the aforesaid arbiters, each of us has affixed his own seal to this letter, which is given after the birth of our Lord Christ, in the year one thousand three hundred and eighty-six, on Saint Bartholomew's Eve, the holy apostle.
